{{Quote|Haor Chall Engineering ''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle. Design is based on the soldier beetles. Upraised stern, bow ramp, clawfoot landing gear.|A [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]]|<ref name="LOE" />}}
The '''''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle''', also known as the '''Neimoidian shuttle''' or the '''Separatist shuttle''', was a craft manufactured by [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall Engineering]]<ref name="LOE" /> and used by high-ranking officials of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to visit potential clients and marketplaces.<ref name="db" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Neimoidianshuttle_negvv.png|thumb|left|150px|An automated [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] without cockpit]]

They were shaped like soldier beetles, and their clawfoot landing legs could only settle down on hard surfaces. This was due to the businessmen's distaste for dealing with poor, underdeveloped worlds.<ref name="db" />

These [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] often had their cockpits removed and replaced by automated [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], so that cabin space could be increased. The ''Sheathipede''-class shuttle was a short-range ship, used only for [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] travel or to ferry passengers to and from an orbital [[Space station/Legends|space station]] or [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="db" />

The personal shuttle of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] was named the ''[[Lapiz Cutter/Legends|Lapiz Cutter]]''. This ship had no weapons, although it was protected by powerful [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].<ref name="db" />

A distinct variant of the Sheathipede had several [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and a seat for a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] next to the pilot, thus widening the cockpit. Due to the additional armament on the dorsal fin, the communications antenna was shortened.<ref name="DC" />

The shuttle resembled the larger [[Neimoidian trader]],<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> the [[Maxillipede shuttle/Legends|Maxillipede shuttle]]<ref name="Secret Weapons">{{TCW|Secret Weapons}}</ref> and the [[Class type B/Legends|Class type B]].

==History==
''Sheathipede''-class shuttles were used by [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] officials to land on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] after they had invaded the planet.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Ten years later, when the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] appeared to go in favor of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], the Neimoidian representatives took off in one of these craft.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] maintained an armed shuttle on board [[Count Dooku's frigate/Legends|his personal frigate]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used it to shoot [[Count Dooku's solar sailer/Legends|his solar sailer]] down over [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], though the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] escaped.<ref name="DC" /> During the [[Battle of Tirahnn (Clone Wars)|Battle of Tirahnn]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Braxus Lyn]] attempted to transport the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Zolghast]] off [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]] in one.<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

<div style="float: right">[[File:Armed_Sheathipede_variant.png|thumb|200px|A Sheathipede model armed with laser weaponry]]</div>
[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] used a shuttle to escape [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] when his [[Landing craft/Legends|landing craft]] crash-landed on the planet. Another shuttle was used by Anakin Skywalker, his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to escape [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Cad Bane's ''Munificent''-class star frigate]] just before it exploded. [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] and her [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] tribe also had a shuttle which they used to travel to [[Dooku's palace/Legends|Dooku's palace]] on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. It may have been a gift from the Count.<ref name="Monster">{{TCW|Monster}}</ref>

Nute Gunray used his personal shuttle along with [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]] to escape [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] at the end of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

General Grievous also used one of these shuttles to land on the planet [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] following the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> His shuttle had an unaltered cockpit, due to the General's distrust of automated systems.<ref name="db" />

After the Clone Wars, few Neimoidians would venture outside their systems unless on business trips. When doing so, they still used ''Sheathipede''-class shuttles.<ref name="ITW:OT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] used an "antique" model of the shuttle on several missions prior to the [[Corellian Treaty]].<ref name="TFU" />

About a [[1 BBY/Legends|year before the Battle of Yavin]], [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]] was chasing [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. At one point, he damaged a landing platform, and a ship of this class (possibly Tarko's personal transport) slid off the platform and plunged to the planet below. Later, Starkiller also saw a hologram of a ''Sheathipede''-class.

==Behind the scenes==
The shuttle was created for its first appearance by [[Industrial Light & Magic|ILM]] employees Larry Tan and [[Adam Savage]] of ''[[Wikipedia:Mythbusters|Mythbusters]]'' fame.<ref name="YouTube">{{YouTube|video=XGFSn2Xm8ks|text=Ask Adam Savage: "Did you ever meet George Lucas?"|channel=@tested|name=Adam Savage's Tested}}</ref>

The shuttle's cockpit resembles that of the [[Wikipedia:Lockheed AH-56 Cheyenne|AH-56 Cheyenne]], a real-world 1960s canceled attack helicopter. It also is similar to that of the [[Wikipedia:Boeing AH-64 Apache|AH-64 Apache]].

In the [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]]/[[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]]/[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]] version of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'', after [[Galen Marek]] rescues Senator Bail Organa from a corrupted [[Maris Brood]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], the senator has a ''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle waiting for him. Organa later uses it to travel to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he, Senators [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], Jedi Master [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], and Marek create the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In the [[Wikipedia:Xbox|Xbox]]/[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|Playstation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] version, he instead uses a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]].

[[The LEGO Group]] made a set of a ''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle called 8036 "Separatist Shuttle" from [[June 28]], [[2009]]. It included Nute Gunray, [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], an [[OOM pilot battle droid/Legends|OOM pilot battle droid]], and two [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. A miniature version was included in 9509 Star Wars Advent Calendar, released August 2012.

In [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'' video game]], the shuttle is armed with [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] and a beam cannon.
